title: Foxy Locks Platinum Fox Purple Blue Toning Shampoo (350ML)
descriptionHtml:
Say goodbye to warm yellow tones with our Platinum Fox Toning Shampoo here at Foxy Locks. Specially formulated with deep violet pigment and colour-correcting technology, our Platinum Fox Toning Shampoo neutralises hair colour and banishes brassiness. As a violet shampoo, it revitalises and re-balances blonde, brunette and grey hair in just three washes; leaving hair cool-toned and shining.

Platinum Fox Toning Shampoo can be used on coloured and highlighted hair, helping to transform colour to reveal silver/ash tones. This violet shampoo is also 100% sulphate free, making it gentler and kinder on the hair and is also ideal for use on hair extensions. For best results, use alongside our Platinum Fox Toning Conditioner.

Anti-Fading

UVA/UVB Filter

Colour Protection for up to 2 weeks

Vegan & Cruelty-free

Size: 350ml

Directions for use on hair:

SHAKE WELL BEFORE USE

Apply to wet hair

Lather evenly and leave for 1-3 minutes

Rinse well

Directions for use on extensions:

SHAKE WELL BEFORE USE

Fill bowl or basin with warm water

Add a few drops (or as desired) of shampoo

Mix into water

Place wet extensions (weft at time) into the water, then remove rapidly (extensions will grab colour fast)

Repeat until desired tone is achieved

Ingredients;
Aqua,sodium Cocoamphoacetate,cocoamidopropyl Betaine,lauryl Glucoside,cocamide Dea,polyquaternium-10 ,hydrolized Keratin,parfum,citric Acid ,methylchloroisothiazolinone and Methylisothiazolinone.

**NEVER apply toner straight to extensions without mixing with water as it may result in an uneven outcome. Make sure the shampoo is well mixed with water before use.

**Ensure the toner is shaken well before use.

descriptionHtml:

Specially formulated to be double the strength, it easily breaks down the adhesive of Tape Hair Extensions, ensuring a quick and clean removal every time. Directions:

2. Leave the solvent to work to soak into the adhesive for 1-2 minutes. For stronger glue leave for 10 minutes or more. Then, use your fingers to gently separate the tape pieces. Add more solvent if needed.

3. Once removed, shampoo hair and extensions to remove any residue.
